runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification and link evidence. Content age and source-verification age are separate; touching updatedAt alone never makes a job fresh.
runSummary.note: Fresh 12.9.2026 20:50 public-web sweep across 13 actually searched source families. No new unique promotion-grade LIVE item was added. Direct Telekom careers surfaced B2B digital-services Business Consultant in Bratislava (2,000 EUR + 15% annual bonus) but it requires at least two years of relevant B2B/product/process experience and English B2, so it is rejected. Telekom Avion sales/customer role in Bratislava (1,750 EUR typical entry compensation) is locally eligible but sales-heavy and weaker than existing LIVE technology/customer roles, so not promoted. A Trainee DBA result disappeared on canonical open and is treated as inactive/unverified, not promoted. Reddit showed US-only/developer-heavy WordPress hiring; Facebook public indexing yielded 0 concrete verifiable hiring posts with direct links.

developmentChanges.title: Role-similarity saturation control
developmentChanges.reason: Before promoting another near-duplicate role from the same employer and track, compare it against the best existing LIVE role on fit, pay, location and requirements. This prevents weaker same-company variants such as another retail sales role from crowding the feed while still allowing a genuinely better variant to replace or outrank the existing one.

developmentChanges.title: Transient listing disappearance recheck
developmentChanges.reason: When a result was indexed as fresh but its canonical detail immediately returns 404 or disappears, record it as transient/inactive and schedule a later source recheck instead of treating the indexed snippet as an active offer. This reduces stale promotions caused by search-index lag.
